cute-dsl.description:
CuTe DSL is a first-class Blackwell code lane. Every PR tagged cute-dsl
(in tags or languages) that touches kernel or example directories is
captured. CuTe DSL tutorial PRs are captured even when the PR is
primarily documentation, because the tutorial code itself is the
teaching material.

skipped: PRs that only touch CUTLASS docs and happen to mention CuTe

triton.description:
Triton is a scoped Blackwell lane. As of Triton 3.6 (released
2026-01-21), Triton has native SM100 lowering through tcgen05 + TMEM
via descriptor/TMA + warp_specialize, tl.dot_scaled, and Gluon
multi-CTA / 2CTA. Those compiler capabilities do not establish a
universal lowering form or performance result for every tl.dot shape.
We therefore capture Triton PRs in three sub-scopes
that remain genuinely useful on Blackwell rather than mirroring the
full CuTe-DSL lane.

See data/version-claims.json::vs-triton-3.6-blackwell-tcgen05 for the
version-sensitive claim record this rationale references.

captured: Triton PRs delivering FP8 memory-bound attention on B200
Triton PRs wiring new SM100 backend dispatch
skipped: Pure SM90/Hopper Triton tuning PRs with no Blackwell relevance
